verdict.rationale: The repo ships a skill-creator meta-skill for creating, iterating on, and benchmarking skills (docs-13, docs-30, docs-14), along with a template SKILL.md (docs-29, docs-73) and an open spec defining required frontmatter and directory layout (docs-17, docs-51, docs-66). Packaging is covered through plugin manifests, local --plugin-dir testing, and marketplace distribution (docs-27, docs-41, docs-8, docs-9), and one community user reports having Claude Code create skills (comm-2). Missing for 10: evidence that the meta-skill itself carries a skill through packaging or validation into a distributable plugin, and independent hands-on corroboration of a full author-to-package run by an agent.
